title: Run Defender for Cloud secure score baseline
description: Capture current secure score and export recommendations as the starting benchmark
checklist: Export secure score report;Document current posture;Share baseline with stakeholders

title: Inventory all subscriptions and resource groups
description: Build a full inventory of subscriptions, resource groups, and owners

title: Review existing RBAC role assignments
description: Audit who has Owner/Contributor at subscription scope

title: Enable MFA for all admin accounts
description: Close the gap on any privileged account without MFA enforced
checklist: Identify accounts without MFA;Enable Conditional Access MFA policy;Verify enforcement

title: Review and remove stale guest accounts
description: Clean up B2B guest accounts with no recent sign-in activity

title: Implement Privileged Identity Management for admin roles
description: Move standing admin access to just-in-time PIM activation
checklist: Enable PIM;Set approval workflow;Migrate top 5 admin roles

title: Enforce Conditional Access policies for risky sign-ins
description: Block or challenge sign-ins flagged as risky by Identity Protection

title: Enable encryption at rest for all storage accounts
description: Confirm customer-managed or platform-managed encryption is active tenant-wide

title: Configure Azure Key Vault access policies
description: Move from broad access policies to least-privilege RBAC on Key Vault

title: Enable soft delete and purge protection on Key Vaults
description: Prevent accidental or malicious permanent deletion of secrets

title: Review and tighten network security group rules
description: Audit inbound/outbound NSG rules across all VNets
checklist: Audit open ports;Remove unused rules;Apply least privilege

title: Enable Azure Firewall for hub-spoke topology
description: Centralize egress filtering through the hub VNet

title: Disable public access on storage accounts where not required
description: Restrict storage accounts to private endpoints or approved networks only

title: Enable Microsoft Sentinel
description: Stand up SIEM coverage for the tenant's core data sources
checklist: Connect data sources;Enable analytics rules;Configure alerting

title: Configure diagnostic settings across subscriptions
description: Route activity and resource logs to the Log Analytics workspace

title: Set up automated incident response playbooks
description: Build Logic App playbooks for common Sentinel alert types

title: Apply Azure Policy for security baseline compliance
description: Assign built-in security baseline initiative across management groups

title: Document final secure score improvement
description: Compare final secure score against the Assessment-phase baseline

title: Present findings to leadership
description: Summarize posture improvements and remaining risk for leadership
